'''Saberhing''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] which manufactured [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] worked as mechanics in a factory on Saberhing before becoming [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] when Han was 20 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.

==Behind the scenes==
It originated in unused background material developed by [[George Lucas]] for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] biography. However, the unused backstory is referred to as in-universe rumors in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
